versions.changelog:
Initial release of meta-recursive-capability-discovery:

- Distilled and enhanced from the original recursive-capability-discovery skill using model-distillation and meta-evolver strategies.
- Adds robust self-verification after each workflow step to ensure output reliability.
- Implements a self-reflection loop to learn from failures and continuously improve.
- Integrates seamlessly into super-agent frameworks, supporting long-term, orchestrated tasks.
- Introduces adversarial testing to validate distilled decision rules and prevent superficial learning.
- Enables ongoing self-evolution via continuous learning with meta-evolver feedback loops.
